inputs.text: In Palakkad on March 28, Pinarayi Vijayan called the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project “political.” But public money and systems that cooperative members depend on demand more than a dismissal: they need transparent decisions and real accountability. When scrutiny is brushed aside as politics, it is ordinary people—not powerful institutions—who risk being left to bear the cost.
